subject: NEW AREAS MILLED: market self-calibration measured (Brier 0.2110, longshot shape), referee crews 21.3-yd spread FLAGS Rung-2, penalty persistence 0.523 = STRONGEST factor candidate, turf +2.55 pts, rest doctrine confirmed
body:
All from the 2019-2025 corpus, scripts + JSON committed on Sports hermes/opp-adj-epa-20260919 @ 1c42f8824 (research README, NEW AREAS section).

1. MARKET SELF-CALIBRATION (never measured directly before): de-vigged close vs outcomes, 6,617 obs: Brier 0.2110, logloss 0.6093, overround 1.0273. Shape: mid-favorites -2-3pp under implied; heavy favorites +3.7pp over. The wedge is in the TAILS, not the middle. This is the benchmark, now on our corpus.

2. REFEREE CREWS (NEW thin-market angle): 20 crews n>=30; penalty-yards/game spans 88.2 (Vinovich) to 109.5 (Hochuli) - spread 21.3 yds, above the pre-stated 15-yd flag. ~1.5-2 pts of expected scoring by PUBLIC crew assignment. Rung-2 candidate; caveat: crews assigned by league grade (proxy risk).

3. PENALTY PERSISTENCE 0.523 (n=32, W1-8 -> W9-18 pen-yds): STRONGEST factor candidate of the night, 3.5x its pre-registered bar, and a direct contrast with turnover occurrence (~0). Penalty discipline is a real, sticky team skill. Rung-1 registered, weight 0.00 until Rung-2 + refit.

4. SURFACE: artificial +2.55 pts/game (45.71 vs 43.16). PRIMETIME: negligible (+1.0). DIVISION: mildly closer/-1.5 total. REST: slope +0.167 pts/day - the tiny-coefficient doctrine CONFIRMED with numbers.

5. SEAT-3 CLOSE-OUT: totals Poisson CRPS 8.167 vs close 7.303 FAIL (close stays the totals mu); aDOT deep-ball penalty GRADUATES at 15-19 mph (-16.6% rel, Wilson non-overlap); 4th&1 run 71.2/pass 54.6 (pasted 53% matches neither).

6. MLB TOTALS CLV STABILITY: 62.4% strict (Apr-Jun starts, n=117) / 56.1% (Jul+, n=321) - both clear the 52% instability kill. PERSISTS. Caveats: single-book fills, grading coverage starts June.

Signal-factory consequence: penalty-discipline + referee-crew + turf + wind-15-19 are now FOUR milled, measured factors ready for Rung-1 registration at weight 0.00 - each with a kill that already ran. That is how N signals that survived a kill looks in practice.
